description: Drains meta-optimization's friction-inbox/* (universal-source intake — any team's members may write via the report-friction skill). Classifies the scope, then routes by writing the entry to friction-report/<scope>/<date>/<slug> on the appropriate sub-member's behalf, or hands off to debt-curator when classification fails. Maintains a daily friction-triage-record/<YYYY-MM-DD> snapshot of throughput by reporter team and destination scope. Router, not analyst — synthesis is debt-curator's job, deep root-cause analysis is conversation-friction-analysis's job.
